AdvisorySource.description: One acquisition of exact bytes. ``source_id`` is the content SHA-256; ``retrieval_id`` the event.
AdvisorySource.title: AdvisorySource

ArtifactIdentity.description:
Identity facts for one side. Bytes-derived fields come only from verified bytes; the file name is
never an identity fact. ``asserted_product_ids`` are analyst input and stay labelled as such.
ArtifactIdentity.title: ArtifactIdentity

CVEFact.description: One ``/vulnerabilities[]`` item exactly as the vendor states it (an advisory claim, never verified).
CVEFact.title: CVEFact

Coverage.description: What was actually inspected. ``exhaustive_for_history`` is the constant False: a scope is never all of history.
Coverage.title: Coverage

IntelligenceReport.description: ``intelligence explain`` result: claims with provenance, hypotheses and explicit unknowns.
IntelligenceReport.title: IntelligenceReport

Score.description: Severity context only (never a vulnerability probability). The score is kept as a decimal string.
Score.title: Score

description: Documentary context per CVE; ``intelligence`` embeds the reused ``intelligence/1`` report where CSAF exists.
title: ContextReport
